bias.en: Bearish, improving · pressing the $243.6 Oct 21 high under the SAR
bias.zh: 偏空但改善 · 逼近 10月21日高点 $243.6，仍低于 SAR

read.en: Coherent rose 1.6% on Oct 28 to $239.59, trading between $232.50 and $242.74. It is above the falling 5-day ($222.8) and 10-day ($229.9) averages and below the falling 30-day ($280.4) and 100-day ($308.3) and the rising 200-day ($296.2). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 12 ($246.37), and RSI is 42.
read.zh: Coherent 10月28日上涨 1.6%，收于 $239.59，盘中区间 $232.50–242.74。股价位于下行的 5 日（$222.8）和 10 日均线（$229.9）上方，低于下行的 30 日（$280.4）和 100 日均线（$308.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$296.2）。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月12日起看空（$246.37），RSI 为 42。

read.en: The close cleared the $236.9 Oct 27 high, now support; the high stopped just under $243.6 (Oct 21 high). Resistance is $242.7–243.6, then $246.4 (SAR) and $252.3 (Oct 15 high). Support is $232.5–236.9 (Oct 28 low, Oct 27 high), then $229.9 (10-day) and $222.3–222.8 (Oct 27 low, 5-day). A close above $243.6 would target $246–252; below $232.5, $222–230.
